svg.title: Wavetable synth — FX tab (proposal)
svg.desc: The synth window's FX tab: the synth's own effect chain of built-in effects (EQ, Chorus, Beat Delay, Reverb) on the left with power buttons and drag to reorder, and the selected EQ's panel with its draggable curve and knobs on the right.
svg.text: VST3 effects go on track inserts
Panel generated from the effect's BuiltinParams — the same code as its own plugin window.
Proposal mockup — sizes and spacing indicative. Effects and their panels are Phase 1's; only the chain list is new.
